shots.title: Match reconciliation targets by exact sprint identity so decimal sprints never mutate neighbours (#618)
shots.notes: Reconciliation now resolves targets through formatRoadmapSprintLabel (string-exact canonical labels), keeps legacy encoded ids (235 ~ S23.5) working, refuses ambiguous identities across sources, and keys scorecard entries by the stored id used in archive evidence lookups.

shots.title: Patch sprint status/outcome in modular YAML sources without reserializing the bundle (#615, #617)

hazards.description: [architect review] Flow-style scorecards section made the patcher append a duplicate top-level key; nothing was written but the error was a raw YAML parse failure instead of the declared fallback. Fixed: patcher declines flow-style scorecards.

[architect review] Invariant reparse errors escaped unclassified instead of triggering fallback; scorecards upsert dropped trailing comments; fallback hardcoded version 1. All fixed in review-fix commit.

[code review] Fail-hard-instead-of-fallback family: empty/comment-only status lines glued scalars, invariant path-normalization asymmetry broke dot-prefixed scorecard refs, dead blockEnd mutation. All fixed; no corruption paths found by adversarial review.

shots.notes: New pure text patcher (src/core/roadmap-source-patch.ts) edits only the targeted status line and scorecards entry; a post-patch semantic invariant reparses and refuses to write if anything else changed; flow-style or mixed-EOL documents fall back to the legacy rewrite with an explicit warning.

shots.title: Add regression fixtures for pre-existing quote/wrap/indent styles and decimal adjacency (#615, #617, #618)
shots.notes: End-to-end fixture proves a styled bundle reconciles byte-exactly except the status line and appended scorecards entry; decimal adjacency, legacy encoded ids, ambiguity refusal, CRLF, and fallback paths all covered.

conditions: Two pre-existing environment-dependent test failures on this machine (doctor guards check, interview alias) reproduce on clean main and are unrelated to this sprint.
bunker_locations: The exact reporter trigger for #618 could not be reproduced locally; the semantic invariant makes the failure class unwritable rather than proving the original mechanism.
yardage_book_updates: completeRoadmapSourceSprint now patches source text surgically; any tool that edits modular roadmap YAML should go through patchRoadmapSourceSprintText or accept reformat fallback warnings.
S240 already shipped fixes for #608 and #611 that remain open on GitHub — verify shipped reality before executing S242-3 and S245.
course_management_notes: Sprint executed on a branch stacked on the Phase 54 triage commits so roadmap, implementation, and scorecard travel in one PR.
